---
title: "Categories Over Time"
subtitle: "Interactive exploration of spending by category"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
---

<div class="control-bar">
  <label for="level-select">Category Level:</label>
  <select id="level-select">
    <option value="category_l1" selected>L1 (broad)</option>
    <option value="category_l2">L2 (detailed)</option>
  </select>

  <label for="topn-select">Top N:</label>
  <select id="topn-select">
    <option value="5">5</option>
    <option value="8">8</option>
    <option value="10" selected>10</option>
    <option value="15">15</option>
  </select>

  <button id="update-btn">Update Chart</button>
</div>

<div id="chart-loading" class="loading-spinner">Initializing DuckDB-Wasm and loading data…</div>
<div id="category-chart" class="chart-container" style="display:none;"></div>

Use the **range selector buttons** (1y/3y/5y/All) or the **range slider** below the chart
to adjust the time window. Click legend entries to toggle categories on/off.
Scroll to zoom; double-click to reset.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Tip
Use the L2 level to see subcategories (e.g., Groceries vs. Restaurants within Food).
:::

```{=html}
<script type="module">
import { renderCategoryTimeSeries } from "./assets/js/explore_charts.js";

async function update() {
  const level = document.getElementById("level-select").value;
  const topN = parseInt(document.getElementById("topn-select").value);

  document.getElementById("chart-loading").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("category-chart").style.display = "block";

  await renderCategoryTimeSeries("category-chart", { level, topN });
}

document.getElementById("update-btn").addEventListener("click", update);
document.getElementById("level-select").addEventListener("change", update);

// Initial render
update();
</script>
```
